finite_quadratic_symplectic.detail: Arf/Witt/classical-group theory can replace some abstract type enumeration after quotienting radicals, but cannot replace source-marked orbit enumeration unless the repo proves its acting source group is the required full classical group. S32-PW06 already owns the transvection-pruner literature interface.

reciprocal_birational.detail: The surviving P0-P2 delta has only B08 as an upstream genus preflight. Rejected Stage36 reciprocal A03 belongs to the broader S35-PW02 involution-quotient contract; A04/A07 are S35-PW03 source-lift specializations. S35-PW04 remains the distinct shared-factor reciprocal compression operation. General birational/Cremona theory does not supply the physical receiver converse.

characters_squareclasses.detail: Pure F2 squareclass linear algebra is already S35-PW01/S34-W01 territory. PW04/PW07 become stronger only when their explicit functions/local rows are bound to a genuine global Kummer/torsor class.

hilbert_reciprocity.detail: Serre Chapter III Theorem 4 gives an exact simultaneous global-realizability criterion for prescribed Hilbert signs once one global variable system is fixed. PW07 currently has dynamic source-dependent reservoirs, so no global obstruction credit follows. Poitou-Tate is relevant only after a genuine finite global module/local-condition system is identified.

twist_rank_mw.detail: PW06 exactly matches Gusic-Tadic injective specialization. PW03 anti-invariant rank algebra is standard twist theory. Rank-jump theorems require additional Stage36 surface hypotheses and do not imply receiver compatibility. Existing LIT-PW01 Mordell-Weil sieve and LIT-PW02 elliptic Chabauty are the preferred terminals if future full-MW/index and receiver adapters become available.

finite_field_weil.detail: No accepted Stage36 card is a finite exceptional-prime classifier. PW07 explicitly forbids that credit. Any finite census plus smooth bounded-genus large-prime Weil completion should route to S35-PW05, and a finite-field point still needs a nonsingular lift argument before p-adic credit.

gaussian_norm.detail: For a genuine cyclic norm equation the Hasse norm theorem can globalize all-place local norm data. PW07 presently supplies directional prime support/local character rows, not one source-locked norm equation. A Gaussian-support-to-global-norm adapter is required and would likely extend the older Gaussian lineage rather than create a new Stage36 terminal.
